zh-CN.title: 广场和人物个性化全面焕新
items: 广场升级为有水景、街区、树木和聚会角落的真实社区场景
人物采用肩肘腕与髋膝踝关节骨架，服装、四肢、手持物和动作各扩展至 8 种
人物相遇会自然挥手，也可以从人物浮层主动打招呼

en.title: A richer plaza and articulated characters
items: The plaza is now a believable community scene with water, streets, trees, and gathering pockets
Characters now use articulated shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, and ankles, with eight choices in every customization category
Nearby characters greet one another naturally, and you can wave from a person's quick panel
